architectural_prerequisite: A signed graphical setup controller, available before target Python/PySide/runtime installation and outside all replacement-owned paths, must own the complete setup lifetime. Existing .pkg/C launcher cannot provide this lifecycle. Home must choose/validate the actual distribution entrypoint and GUI host; this packet selects the question flow, not an implemented packaging technology.
lifecycle_boundary: From before native package/application changes through user-runtime setup, retry/cancel, activation, optional accounts and finalverified/result GUI. No helper starts Terminal for product questions after Installer.app closes. Standard macOS authorization/security UI is separate and OS-owned.

pages.purpose: Setup language independent of runtime, accounts and privileges

proposed_defaults.setup_language: existing preferred installer/app language when known; otherwise supported OS locale then en

pages.lifecycle_and_transition: Native controller must already run without target Python/PySide. Changing language changes this GUI immediately; application preferences only if explicitly chosen.

pages.purpose: Requested release, existing copy and destination
pages.lifecycle_and_transition: Discover only owned installations/launchers and identify protected custom roots. Higher verified version branches newer; same version branches repair. Existing package/environment/offline overrides must be visible or refused; no silent otherrelease.
No replacement; verify selected existing launcher and actual app ready. Requested older release is not claimed installed.
Same-version operation is labelled reinstall, with staged replacement and preservation; not disguised version upgrade.

pages.purpose: Downloads, disk, dependencies and OS authorization scope

proposed_defaults.admin: requested only for identified package/application operation

pages.lifecycle_and_transition: Controller retains original user identity/root across OS elevation. Apple authorization window is OS-owned; no product/privacy choices or password capture there. Package exit0 only payload status; per-user setup remains in controller.

pages.purpose: Install package choice versus observed active backend

proposed_defaults.update: preserve compatible saved requested backend; review change explicitly

pages.lifecycle_and_transition: Show detected runtime backend separately. CPU package selection alone cannot claim runtime noMPS. Unsupported/offline backend choices are refused or revised with explicit review, not silently changed.

proposed_defaults.update: preserve existing preferences unless explicitly reviewed change

pages.lifecycle_and_transition: Requires future reporting-route guard acceptance before promising per-report review. Product preferences are distinct from particular manual/automatic report consent.

pages.purpose: Optional provider setup with no Terminal dependency
pages.lifecycle_and_transition: After verified installation, offer only reviewed official graphical/browser sign-in routes. Provider-specific unsupported interactiveCLI routes are labelled unavailable and skippable; no Terminal fallback, no provider/auth session performed here. Do not collect credentials or infer tool/action approval from login.

pages.purpose: Preserve files and inspect optional cleanup
pages.lifecycle_and_transition: Expanded GUI inventory shows exact folder path and child names/types/counts/size, relevant models/data and unreadable items. Eligible cache/temp objects only; mixed/protected/unknown roots cannot be removed wholesale. Replacement blocks if required preservation proof cannot be established. Native userpaths remain local/private.

Consent binds exact selected eligible objects and display inventory, rechecked before removal. No use of current broad purge. Automatic cleanup limited to identified transaction-owned staging needed for replacement; report it separately. Partial results shown truthfully.

pages.purpose: Prepare before retiring old app; keep GUI alive

proposed_defaults.activation: no mutation until staged validation and explicit requested closure

pages.lifecycle_and_transition: Controller lives outside replacement roots, owns progress and bounded cancellation/retry. It remains alive after oldapp closes. Stage/verify, cooperate with shutdown, activate, verify launch identities and fresh actual GUI acknowledgment. No Terminal question window; OS security dialogs stay OS-owned.

pages.purpose: Verified requested or retained-newer app and preservation summary
pages.lifecycle_and_transition: Keep window until app-ready and data/selected cleanup results resolved. Display local identity details optionally; installer/helper exit0 or OS launch request is not ready. Completion message names effective launched version truthfully.

Precommit cancellation retains workingold state; postactivation cancellation/failure follows controlled recovery. Verified restored message requires previous actual GUI plus code/launcher and data checks; otherwise no green success. Never erase unknown/conflicting rollback files merely to finish.
